_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Web-Based Course Test Plan
summary: Describes the contractor's testing procedures for verifying that web-based courses properly integrate and function within the government's Learning Management System (LMS).
use_relationship:
The Test Plan will be used to describe the contractor's testing procedures.  These procedures will show measures taken by the contractor to ensure web-based courses developed properly integrate and function within the governments' Learning Management System (LMS).  The government will also use this plan to evaluate the contractor's proposed test procedures.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The issue of this document cited herein, including its approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Test Plan shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Test Plan shall contain the following:

children.title: An overview of the test objectives
children.content: of the test plan, including flow diagrams, milestones, personnel participation to include subject matter experts, locations, and schedules.

children.title: The test plan shall contain procedures
Functional testing of the courseware materials
children.content: on the LMS vendor site as specified in the contract.

children.title: Hyper links and verification
children.content: that the targeted URL accurately loads.

children.title: The plan shall also document the navigation
children.content: within the module and that it works correctly throughout each module (i.e., forwards and backwards) and takes the user to the correct destination.

children.title: The plan shall identify Shareable Content Object (SCO)
children.content:
and that it is compliant and passes all the correct data to the government's LMS at the correct point of time in each SCO.

This information shall consist of at least initialization, finalization, incomplete, complete, student's score, student ID, progress tracking, and book-marking.
